_doc: PURPOSE-GRANTS-1108 (owner 2026-11-08: "Allow educational|research|etc should also be a green light for us"). One purpose vocabulary read by vera/purpose_grants.py. mode off|shadow: shadow records 'would admit under purpose grant' (codes in the request trace, verbatim evidence in an owner-only in-process ring) and changes NO admission. There is no 'on' mode: admission needs calibration on real traces and an owner decision; any other value means off. A grant counts only from site-owner channels (site_channels): robots.txt full-line comments and fields, HTTP response headers of the fetched page, and the host's own /.well-known/tdmrep.json. Page meta, page body and anything third-party are never grants. A grant can only lift restrictions in overridable (generic AI or TDM use restrictions it carves out); everything in never_overridable stays binding whatever a grant says. No per-site lists: matching is generic over the terms below.
_calibration: PROVISIONAL, no real data yet: window 5 and carveout_window 4 (tokens between a purpose term and a permit/negation/carve-out term) and the limits were set on hand-written fixtures only (tests/test_purpose_grants_1108.py). They decide nothing in shadow mode, which exists to collect the real data: per-host would_admit/review events and their verbatim lines from production traces. Data that would change them: verbatim lines judged misread (window too wide) or missed (too narrow) in the shadow evidence review. No 'on' mode ships before that review and an owner decision.

robots_ai_statement.reason: robots.txt comment says AI crawlers/assistants are blocked; a grant on the same comment line (carve-out) or an AI-scoped purpose grant in the same robots.txt lifts it

use_no_ai_signal.reason: generic no-AI use signal (noai, Content-Signal ai-input=no, Content-Usage ai-use=n); only an AI-scoped or carve-out purpose grant from the same site lifts it

use_tdm_reserved.reason: TDM reservation; only a TDM-scoped purpose grant from the same site lifts it. A tdm-policy that is present but unread goes to review

_never_note: robots_ai_agent_block (hyperscaler-only groups) stays binding pending owner decision H13. read_robots_disallow covers own-token and * disallows. The licence reject list (ND, no-educational-use, strictly-for-fee), login/paywall, deny list, registry forbid and rate/Crawl-delay limits are never lifted by a grant.
